charge_port.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: NACS from model year 2026; model year 2025 and earlier Hyundai EVs use an adapter for NACS (the port itself is inferred to be CCS from that).

supercharger_access.notes: Hyundai Canada FAQ: Hyundai EVs of model year 2025 and earlier can use a NACS adapter sold separately at Tesla Superchargers open to Hyundai drivers.
